name: debt_grid_choice_with_signed_ebit_revision
question_template: Use exact arithmetic. A firm's unlevered value is {VU} USD million. Base EBIT is {EBIT0} USD million and management reports a one-time EBIT revision of {REV} USD million, where a positive figure raises EBIT and a negative figure is a loss that lowers it; adjusted EBIT is base EBIT plus the signed revision. The corporate tax rate is {TAX} percent. The firm must pick one debt level from the grid 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4 times {STEP} USD million. Debt at grid level k (k from 1 to 4) carries an annual interest rate of {R0} percent plus 1 percentage point for each level above level 1, so level 1 pays {R0} percent. A level is admissible only if its annual interest, debt times its rate, does not exceed adjusted EBIT; level 0 is always admissible. For each admissible level, firm value equals unlevered value plus a tax shield of tax rate times debt, minus an expected distress cost of {DC} percent of the debt above a threshold equal to {MULT} times adjusted EBIT (zero if debt is at or below the threshold). The firm chooses the admissible level with the highest firm value; ties go to the lower debt level. Equity value is the chosen firm value minus the chosen debt. Report the equity value in USD million.

slots.description: Adjusted EBIT after applying the signed revision, USD million
Largest grid debt whose interest does not exceed adjusted EBIT, USD million
Debt level selected after tie-break, USD million
Firm value at the chosen debt level, USD million

program:
def solve():
    VU = Fraction(P["VU"])
    ebit0 = Fraction(P["EBIT0"])
    rev = Fraction(P["REV"])
    tax = Fraction(P["TAX"]) / 100
    step = Fraction(P["STEP"])
    r0 = Fraction(str(P["R0"])) / 100
    dc = Fraction(P["DC"]) / 100
    mult = Fraction(str(P["MULT"]))
    ebit = ebit0 + rev
    if ebit <= 0:
        raise ValueError("adjusted EBIT must be positive")
    threshold = mult * ebit
    best_debt = None
    best_value = None
    highest_adm = Fraction(0)
    for k in range(0, 5):
        debt = k * step
        if k == 0:
            interest = Fraction(0)
        else:
            rate = r0 + Fraction(k - 1) / 100
            interest = debt * rate
        if interest > ebit:
            continue
        if debt > highest_adm:
            highest_adm = debt
        excess = debt - threshold
        if excess < 0:
            excess = Fraction(0)
        value = VU + tax * debt - dc * excess
        if best_value is None or value > best_value:
            best_value = value
            best_debt = debt
    equity = best_value - best_debt
    return {
        "final": equity,
        "adjusted_ebit": ebit,
        "highest_admissible_debt": highest_adm,
        "chosen_debt": best_debt,
        "chosen_firm_value": best_value,
    }
